base_prompt: Turkish alternative pop, intimate live studio band, instrumental only. Warm acoustic guitar, expressive piano, melodic electric bass, real drum kit, restrained clean electric guitar. Cohesive memorable recurring two-bar lead motif, human microtiming and touch, breathing room for a future singer. No EDM drop, no genre switch, no dense synth layers, no vocals or speech. Key B minor, 102 BPM, 4/4. Lead motif: The signature hook is a bittersweet melodic motif in B minor, scaling from the dominant F# up to B, C#, and a sustained, syncopated D on the upbeat, followed by a sudden breathy fall back to B and A. It emphasizes a wistful, sigh-like cadence that mirrors the heavy atmosphere of a basement..

timeline.name: intro
timeline.arrangement: Starts with a dry, intimate fingerpicked acoustic guitar in B minor accompanied by real, low-fidelity tape hiss. A warm upright piano drops occasional low-register B notes to lock in the melancholic vibe.

timeline.name: verse_1
timeline.arrangement: A muted, warm kick drum pulses softly on beats 1 and 3, paired with a subtle, dry rimshot on 4. An organic, melodic bass slides between chord roots. Gentle electric guitar swells color the tail of each line.

timeline.name: pre_1
timeline.arrangement: Sub-bass pad replaces the active bass, adding a deep, tense rumble. A 16th-note shaker and a soft, building snare roll build anticipation. The acoustic guitar switches to a muted, rhythmic 16th-note pattern.

timeline.name: chorus_1
timeline.arrangement: The arrangement opens up with a warm, driving acoustic strumming pattern. A dry, organic snare hits on 2 and 4 with delicate ghost notes. A clean electric guitar plays the ambient melodic hook.

timeline.name: turnaround
timeline.arrangement: Instantly drops back to the sparse, fingerpicked acoustic guitar motif of the intro. A single, soft ride cymbal decays naturally, accompanied by a slow, sliding bass note resolving to B.

timeline.name: verse_2
timeline.arrangement: Similar rhythm groove to verse 1, but augmented by a warm, off-beat Rhodes piano progression. The bass line becomes slightly more expressive, weaving high-register melodic countermelodies.

timeline.name: pre_2
timeline.arrangement: Recreates the build of pre_1 but introduces a subtle reverse cymbal swell and a deep, low-frequency acoustic tom roll to maximize the dynamic transition into the second chorus.

timeline.name: chorus_2
timeline.arrangement: Full strummed acoustic guitar and active bass groove. A warm, subtle organ swell is introduced in the background to expand the mid-range and heighten the bittersweet tension of the track.

timeline.name: bridge
timeline.arrangement: Drums and acoustic guitars cut out completely to create a stark, exposed space. A slow, heavily tremolo-treated Rhodes piano plays warm, jazzy extensions over a dry, deep bass guitar line.
timeline.chords: Em7 - A7 - Dmaj7 - Gmaj7 - Em - F#7

timeline.name: final_chorus
timeline.arrangement: The dynamic peak. Full live drums with tasteful, driving tom fills. The main electric hook guitar is double-tracked and given a slightly grittier overdrive, supported by lush, swelling string synths.

timeline.name: outro
timeline.arrangement: All percussion drops out. A single fingerpicked acoustic guitar slowly fades out, accompanied by a sustaining Rhodes chord. The track resolves on a final, whispered breath and a long, low Bm piano chord.
